{{Top|leg}}
'''Gumbah pudding''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] that could turn rancid.<ref name="CT2">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref> It could be used alongside [[charbote root]].<ref name="TGHH">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gumbah pudding was first mentioned in [[Roger MacBride Allen]]'s [[1995]] novel ''[[Assault at Selonia]]''.<ref name="CT2" />
